name: device-login-hostkey-first-use

graded_by.test: core/internal/ws/device_login_test.go — TestAFirstUseKeyIsAskedAuditedAndRelayedBeforeAnyPrompt: device_login_hostkey first, target.hostkey_accepted written before hostkey_answer is relayed, no prompt before the answer

description: A key the worker has never recorded is fetched by a key-only probe connection and shown before any user name reaches the device: `hostkey_ask` (C3) becomes `device_login_hostkey {kind: first_use, fingerprint}`, and no `device_login_prompt` comes before the operator's answer. The core writes `target.hostkey_accepted` or `target.hostkey_refused` before it relays the decision, the line recording the operator's decision (L3), and a line that cannot be written for an acceptance refuses it and ends the login (C2/device-login-hostkey-audit-unwritable). `kind` has one value at this release; a consumer that meets another sends `device_login_cancel` and never offers Accept.

instances.note: the first-use key, in OpenSSH SHA256 form
not a kind of this release
